text: dsh-llm-model-tuning 是面向 DSH Web Models 设置页的模型配置插件。它在自定义 llm-pi-ai 供应商卡片中提供每个模型的推理档位与文本、图像等输入类型设置，也可从供应商网关读取模型列表，选择后导入配置；缺少模型详情时可用 models.dev 补全。用户可编辑模型条目并保存或放弃修改。模型列表请求由宿主代理处理，models.dev 仅用于补充目录信息。

dsh-llm-model-tuning adds per-model reasoning and input settings to custom providers in DSH Web Models. Users can fetch a gateway model list, select entries to import, edit the resulting draft, then save or discard it. Missing model details can be completed from models.dev.
想给自定义供应商里的每个模型单独设置推理档位。
如何标记某个模型支持图片输入？
I want to import available models from my provider gateway into settings.
dsh-llm-model-tuning 的功能「逐模型调优」：在 Models 设置的自定义供应商卡片中，为模型编辑推理档位和输入类型，并可添加或移除模型条目；保存后写入该供应商设置。
dsh-llm-model-tuning 的功能「从网关导入模型」：用户触发获取模型后，宿主读取供应商 /models 列表并展示可选条目；确认选择会合并到草稿，用户再保存应用。
dsh-llm-model-tuning 使用前须知：导入时会请求配置的模型供应商网关；模型详情不全时还会读取 models.dev 公共目录补全信息。
dsh-llm-model-tuning 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 6 天；提交数 5；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · dsh-llm-model-tuning：Adds a per-model **reasoning-effort** and **multimodal input** editor to every custom provider card on the DeepSeek Harness **Settings → Models** page, rendered in the same visual language as the shipped page, plus a **Magpie gateway import** that can pull a provider's `/models` listing, translate its Magpie extension fields into `llm-pi-ai` model entries, and let you pick which of them to import from a searchable selection dialog before filing them into the card's draft.

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · dsh-llm-model-tuning：When that listing does not disclose a model's details — a bare OpenAI-style `{"id":…}` row, or one that names only a context window — the Host **completes the missing settings from [models.dev](https://models.dev/)**, matching decorated ids such as `xxx/gpt-6.1-sol`, `cn:deepseek-flash` or `cn:kimi-k3-1` to their catalog model instead of guessing from the raw string. Gateways that spell model detail differently are understood too: WorkBuddy-style `attachments`/`supports_images` feed `input`, and `reasoning_supported_efforts`/`supports_reasoning`/`only_reasoning` feed `reasoningEfforts`, so a WorkBuddy import carries the modalities and reasoning the gateway itself spells out even when the catalog is unreachable. The completion is shown in the dialog (`补全` badges and a summary line), never overrides what the gateway itself disclosed, and a models.dev outage only costs the completion — the import still succeeds. The selection dialog also **sizes itself to the model names** it lists, so a long id or display name is readable in full instead of hidden behind an ellipsis.

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · dsh-llm-model-tuning：> **Requires dsh 0.1.7 or newer.** This card writes settings through the `configForms` service; the older `settingsScope` service was removed in 0.1.7. The gateway import additionally uses the Connection exact Fetch-route registry (`ctx.connection.fetch.register`). The manifest declares that floor as `engines.dsh: ">=0.1.7"`, which DSH evaluates with prereleases included — see [Compatibility with DSH updates](#compatibility-with-dsh-updates).

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · dsh-llm-model-tuning：Reasoning effort is a *per-model* capability — the models under one provider disagree about it, so a provider-scoped control could only be set to a value some of them reject. This plugin keeps a per-model editor with its own granularity (including the wire spelling each level sends) and adds the gateway import that the shipped editor does not perform: it lists the route's own model entries, lets you choose which gateway models to add or overwrite, and edits two fields on each:

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · dsh-llm-model-tuning：| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `reasoningEfforts` | Which effort levels the model offers, and the wire spelling each one sends. `false` declares a non-reasoning model; absent inherits the installed catalog. |
| `input` | Which request modalities the model accepts (`text`, `image`). Absent inherits the installed catalog. |

It also edits the route-level `defaultInput` fallback, which is what makes a gateway serving vision models the catalog does not describe usable.

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · dsh-llm-model-tuning：Both fields are written into the `llm-pi-ai` settings section, so a change reaches the next request with no restart — the adapter resolves profiles per request.

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · 从网关导入模型 — Magpie import with model selection：Expand a custom provider card and click **获取可用模型** (the button reads `正在询问提供商…` and is disabled while the request runs). The card stays a thin client: the Host half resolves the provider's profile and credential, fetches `GET {baseURL}/models`, maps the Magpie extensions to storable `llm-pi-ai` entries, and answers the page.

A listing with at least one importable model opens the **选择要添加的模型** dialog (an empty listing reports the warn status `网关没有返回可导入的模型。` instead):

text: dsh-llm-model-tuning README · 缺失模型详情时自动补全 — models.dev enrichment：A gateway does not have to disclose anything beyond `id` — the common OpenAI-compatible answer is `{"data":[{"id":"gpt-6.1-sol"}, …]}`. When at least one mapped entry is missing one of `contextWindow`, `maxTokens`, `input`, or `reasoningEfforts`, the Host looks the model up in the public [models.dev](https://models.dev/) catalog (`https://models.dev/api.json`) and fills the missing `llm-pi-ai` fields before the selection dialog opens:
section: 缺失模型详情时自动补全 — models.dev enrichment

text:
dsh-llm-model-tuning README · 缺失模型详情时自动补全 — models.dev enrichment：- **The gateway always wins.** A field the gateway disclosed is never replaced; only absent fields are completed. An entry that already discloses every detail field triggers no lookup at all; a model whose only gap is its reasoning levels is still looked up, and keeps the gateway's own `网关提示` beside the completed effort map (or beside nothing when models.dev has no effort data either).
- **Best effort, never fatal.** The catalog is fetched with a 10 s deadline and cached in memory for 6 hours. A timeout, an HTTP failure, or a malformed catalog only skips the completion (`modelsDev.available: false` plus a human-readable `error`); the import itself still succeeds with the gateway mapping.
- **Reasoning can be completed too.** Because a missing effort map counts as a gap, a gateway entry that says nothing about reasoning can receive models.dev's effort levels; the dialog marks it with `补全`, and every completed value stays editable in the card.
- The catalog is consulted by the Host only. The page keeps calling the same same-origin route; the browser fetches nothing extra and no credential is involved.

text: dsh-llm-model-tuning README · 智能匹配 — how decorated ids are matched：Gateway ids are often decorated with a provider/category segment, or spell the same model differently (case, dots vs. dashes, a `canonical_model_id`). Matching normalizes case and separators, then considers the full id, every tail after a `/` or `:` separator, the disclosed display name, and — on the catalog side — model ids, `canonical_model_id`s, names and families:
section: 智能匹配 — how decorated ids are matched

text:
dsh-llm-model-tuning README · 智能匹配 — how decorated ids are matched：| Gateway id | Matched catalog model | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `xxx/gpt-6.1-sol` | `openai/gpt-6.1-sol` | an unknown provider prefix is peeled; the catalog's authoritative vendor (`openai`) wins over aggregator copies of the same model |
| `cn:deepseek-flash` | `deepseek/deepseek-flash` | a `:` category prefix is peeled; the official vendor beats resellers |
| `cn:kimi-k3-1` | `moonshotai/kimi-k3` | a short **local disambiguation suffix** (`-1`, `-b`, `-ctrl`, `-exp`, …) is peeled as a last resort when no direct match exists; the catalog's authoritative vendor wins |
| `cn:hy3-b` / `cn:hy4-preview-ctrl` | `aihubmix/hy3` / `aihubmix/hy4-preview` | the same local-suffix rule |
| `openai/gpt-6.1-sol` | provider `openai`, model `gpt-6.1-sol` | the provider prefix names a catalog provider |
| `@cf/openai/gpt-oss-20b` | `@cf/openai/gpt-oss-20b` (canonical `openai/gpt-oss-20b`) | an exact catalog id wins; nested vendor prefixes are peeled when no full id matches |
| `claude/claude-haiku-5-5` | `anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5` | a provider alias resolves through a catalog tail key; the authoritative vendor then wins |
| `C
section: 智能匹配 — how decorated ids are matched

text: dsh-llm-model-tuning README · 智能匹配 — how decorated ids are matched：Ambiguity is resolved deterministically: an exact catalog id beats a canonical-id match; a match from the hinted provider, or from the model's own vendor (the prefix of its `canonical_model_id`), beats another provider's copy; a more complete record beats a sparse one; then provider and model id order decide. A guarded last tier maps a *versionless family alias* (`claude-haiku`, `gpt-sol`) to the family's catalog record — deterministic, but only a hint: that record may be an older or newer member of the family. Below that, an id whose only difference from a catalog id is a trailing **local disambiguation marker** (a single letter or digit, `ctrl`, or `exp`) is matched to the base model (`cn:kimi-k3-1` → `kimi-k3`); this tier never receives the provider/vendor bonuses, so it can never outrank a normal match. Only one such token is peeled: a longer invented suffix stays unmatched (`gpt-6.1-turbo`), while a trailing version-like token can still resolve to the base model (`gpt-6.1-sol-2` → `gpt-6.1-sol`, `cn:kimi-k3-2` → `kimi-k3`) — that is a heuristic hint rather than proof of the exact variant.
section: 智能匹配 — how decorated ids are matched

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · 补全字段 — what is filled in：| models.dev field | Written `llm-pi-ai` field | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `limit.context` | `contextWindow` | The positive integer. |
| `limit.output` | `maxTokens` | The positive integer. |
| `modalities.input` | `input` | Filtered to `text` and `image` (`pdf`/`audio`/`video` are dropped silently); text stays the floor; canonical order `["text","image"]`. |
| `reasoning_options[].values` (`type: "effort"`) | `reasoningEfforts` | `none`/`off` become `off: null`; only the seven levels the schema accepts survive (`off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`), each spelled with its own name; other values are skipped. |
| `reasoning_options` (`type: "toggle"`) | `reasoningEfforts` | Adds `off: null` when there is at least one usable effort level; a toggle-only model yields no effort map. |
| `reasoning_options` (`type: "budget_tokens"`) | — | Ignored: a thinking-token budget is not an effort level. |
| `reasoning: false` | `reasoningEfforts: false` | Declares a non-reasoning model. |
| `reasoning: true` with no usable level | — | Omitted rather than guessed; the installed catalog answers. |
| `name` | `name` | Only

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · 响应与界面 — response shape and UI：The import route's success body grows one optional key, present only when a lookup was attempted (the old `{ ok, models, warnings }` shape is unchanged otherwise):

```json
{
  "ok": true,

An unreachable or unusable catalog still answers HTTP 200 with the mapped entries; the failure is reported beside them:

text:
dsh-llm-model-tuning README · 响应与界面 — response shape and UI：```json
{ "ok": true, "models": [ /* … */ ], "warnings": [], "modelsDev": { "source": "models.dev", "available": false, "error": "获取 models.dev 目录超时，已跳过自动补全" } }
```

A request body may pass `"enrich": false` to skip the completion entirely.

text: dsh-llm-model-tuning README · 响应与界面 — response shape and UI：In the dialog, a completion hint (`已通过 models.dev 自动补全 N 个模型的设置。`) appears above the candidate list, every completed candidate carries a `补全` badge whose hover title names the filled fields (`名称、上下文、最大输出、输入类型、推理档位`), and confirming the import appends `models.dev 补全：N 个模型` to the status line when at least one selected enriched model was actually imported. When the catalog was unavailable the dialog says so (`models.dev 补全不可用：<error>`) instead. An older Host that never sends `modelsDev` shows no completion hint, no `补全` badges and no completion count; the adaptive dialog width is independent of the payload and applies regardless.

text: dsh-llm-model-tuning README · 对话框宽度 — the selection dialog sizes itself：The dialog no longer fixes its width at 380 px: it estimates the room the longest candidate id and display name need (CJK counted double), clamps the result to 380–920 px, and caps it at the viewport (`calc(100vw - 48px)`). Candidate ids and names wrap instead of being ellipsized — each row also carries a `title` with the full `id · name` — and the width is computed over **all** candidates, so typing in `搜索模型` never makes the dialog jump.

text: dsh-llm-model-tuning README · How it is put together：**Client card.** It renders the same visual language as the shipped Models page: a collapsed header (`模型调优` / `展开配置`), then the provider-level `默认输入类型` fallback, the `从网关导入` group, the `模型（N）` list whose entries expand through `模型选项` into `输入类型` checkboxes and a `推理能力` select (inherit / off / custom level rows with `添加档位` / `删除档位`), an add-model row, and `保存` / `放弃修改` actions. The import opens the selection dialog described above: it sizes itself to the candidate names, shows the `补全` badges/models.dev hint when the Host completed settings, and reports the completion count after confirming.

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · How it is put together：It registers on the `settings.models.provider-card` seat under the `llm-pi-ai` namespace, keyed by the provider row's own settings namespace. Because every configurable pi-ai route declares `settingsNs: 'llm-pi-ai'`, a single registration under that key receives every custom-provider card — saved rows and the add-provider draft alike — without the Models section knowing anything about this plugin. The card follows the namespace through `configForms.whileServed`, so a deployment without that adapter shows no trace of it, and it reads/writes the namespace through a `configForms` form (`getSnapshot`/`subscribe`/`mutate`).

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · How it is put together：**Host half.** The entry is no longer empty: it injects `settings`, `credentials`, and `connection` and registers one exact Connection Fetch route. The page only calls this route; the API key never reaches the browser. The route also performs the optional models.dev completion (a plain public catalog fetch with its own deadline and cache — no credential involved), so the browser never talks to models.dev and the returned entries are already complete. The pure matching/completion rules live in `lib/modelsdev.js` (also exported as `dsh-llm-model-tuning/modelsdev`), and the Host re-exports `fetchModelsDevCatalog()` / `resetModelsDevCache()` for live checks and tests.

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · How it is put together：```
POST /api/dsh-llm-model-tuning/models
content-type: application/json
{ "provider": "<route id>", "settingsNs": "llm-pi-ai", "enrich": true }   // last two optional; settingsNs defaults llm-pi-ai, enrich to true
```

Success — HTTP 200:

```json
{ "ok": true, "models": [ /* storable llm-pi-ai model entries */ ], "warnings": ["group/never-stuck：跳过 DSH 不支持的推理档位 ultra"] }
```

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · How it is put together：When a models.dev lookup was attempted the body also carries the optional `modelsDev` key (shape in [缺失模型详情时自动补全](#缺失模型详情时自动补全--modelsdev-enrichment)); `"enrich": false` in the request body skips it entirely.

Failure — HTTP 400 (bad request / unknown provider / unsupported protocol / unusable profile) or 502 (gateway unreachable, auth refused, non-JSON listing, missing credential):

```json
{ "ok": false, "message": "给用户看的中文说明" }
```

Host behaviour:

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · How it is put together：1. Reads the live `llm-pi-ai` descriptor from `ctx.settings.describe({ redactSecrets: true })` and takes `value.providers[<route>]` — the resolved profile, so a route declared only in the composition base/`cordis.patch.yml` is found too. A missing namespace or route answers 400.
2. Chooses the listing endpoint from `profile.api` (default `openai-completions`):
   - `openai-completions` / `openai-responses`: `GET {baseURL without a trailing slash}/models`
   - `anthropic-messages`: strips a trailing `/v1` from `baseURL`, then `GET {root}/v1/models?limit=1000` with `x-api-key` and `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`
   - anything else answers 400 `该协议不支持自动拉取模型列表`.
3. Starts from the profile's `headers` (string values only), sets `accept: application/json`, and adds the auth header. If `profile.apiKeyEnv` is set, `await ctx.credentials.resolve(ref)` supplies the key; a missing credential answers 502 naming the reference. With no `apiKeyEnv` the listing is fetched unauthenticated.
4. Fetches with a 20 s timeout, answers 502 `网关返回 HTTP <status>` on a non-2xx response (401/403 adds a check-the-key hint), and maps a non-JSON body to 502 as

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · How it is put together：The route is registered with `ctx.effect(() => ctx.connection.fetch.register({ path, methods: ["POST"], requestBody: "buffered", fetch }))`, so it is disposed with the plugin's fiber. The `/api` prefix authenticates the browser session before any exact route is dispatched; the handler only ever sees the authenticated same-origin page.

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · Install：Install the bundle with the plugin manager, pointing it at this directory:

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <absolute path to this package>
```

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · Install：That performs the package installation and bundle selection itself — it adds the
dependency, links it into the active profile's `node_modules`, and appends the
package to `dsh.profile.bundles` because it declares `dsh.bundle.patch`. Do not
hand-edit the profile's `package.json` or `cordis.patch.yml`, and do not run a
package manager in the profile directory.

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · Install：The install is a **symlink** to this directory, so later edits here are picked up
without reinstalling. A freshly installed bundle can activate through HMR; a
replaced one needs a profile restart to load a fresh JavaScript module
generation.

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · Compatibility with DSH updates：Before a profile imports a bundle, DSH compares the runtime version against the
bundle's manifest. `engines.dsh` decides alone, with prereleases included
(`semver.satisfies(runtime, range, { includePrerelease: true })`); without it,
every `@deepseek-ai/dsh` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer must match the runtime. An
unmet requirement is reported as `incompatible-version` and the bundle is
**skipped at startup** — the plugin is still installed and selected, but nothing
it provides loads. A DSH update therefore cannot be "waited out": an official
bundle pinned to the previous build's exact peer versions needs the matching
bundle version.

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · Compatibility with DSH updates：| What this bundle declares | Why it survives an update |
| --- | --- |
| `engines.dsh: ">=0.1.7"` | A floor with no upper bound, so the 0.2.x nightly prereleases (verified against `0.2.1-rc.5` and the published `0.2.2-rc.1`) and later runtimes are admitted. |
| No `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer dependency | No exact build pin can go stale. The only peer is `@deepseek-ai/cordis: ^4.0.1`, which covers both the 4.0.5 runtime and the 4.1.x runtime of 0.2.2. |
| `engines.node: ">=20"` | Covers the Node 24 runtime that 0.2.2 requires. |

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · Compatibility with DSH updates：The API surfaces this plugin uses were compared between 0.2.1-rc.5 and
0.2.2-rc.1: `dsh-client-ui-settings`' `configForms` service (including
`whileServed`) and `dsh-client-ui-settings-models`' slot contract are
byte-identical, `dsh-client-connection`'s Fetch-route types are identical, and
the `llm-pi-ai` model fields the card writes (`models` / `modelOverrides` /
`defaultInput`, `input`, `reasoningEfforts`, capacities) are unchanged. The
0.2.2 adapter adds provider-level `maxRequestImages` / `imageOffloadCountQuantum`
fields and changes default capacities; path-addressed writes leave those fields
untouched.

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · Compatibility with DSH updates：To check the card's output against the **next runtime's real adapter schema**,
install that adapter in a scratch directory and point the two schema-checked
suites at it (both suites pass against `0.2.2-rc.1`; on Windows replace

dsh-llm-model-tuning README · What the card does with your document：- **Edit surface.** The card reads and writes the *user* layer of the `llm-pi-ai` section. A route declared only in the composition base is read from the resolved value so it can still be tuned; writing it is what materializes it in the user layer.
- **Path-addressed writes.** Every hand edit travels as `settings.mutate` path ops against the stored section, so fields the card never rendered cannot be deleted. The one deliberate exception is the gateway import: for a model you select in the dialog it rebuilds the five managed fields in the draft, which is what makes an overwrite able to clear a value the gateway no longer discloses. `id` and unmanaged fields are kept. The namespace revision fences a stale card against a concurrent change.
- **`models` vs `modelOverrides`.** A `models` list *replaces* the installed catalog, while `modelOverrides` reshapes it. The adapter refuses both together, so the card edits whichever the profile already uses and offers to add `modelOverrides` entries when neither is present. Compat switches, edits to other model fields, and credentials stay with the shipped editor and `settings.yaml`.
- **Gateway import overwrites what you select.** For an existing model, every selected import replaces all five managed fields and clears any of them the gateway no longer discloses — that is the point of the overwrite, not a bug. Unselected rows and models the gateway does not return are never touched.

- Settings are stored in the user's `settings.yaml`; the card holds no state of its own.
